title: Bubble Shooter
description: Aim colorful bubbles to clear matching clusters and drop disconnected groups.
instructions: Move the mouse to aim and click to launch a bubble. Match three or more of one color.
licenseNotes: The repository LICENSE is MIT, while bubble-shooter-example.js expressly specifies GPL-3.0-or-later. Both notices are retained. Original bubble sprite sheet is supplied in the MIT repository.
modifications: Added a descriptive page title and centered the game on a dark background.
